```{r a function to estimate total and direct effects}

options(mc.cores = parallel::detectCores())
#
run_adjusted_model <- function(
  dag,
  exposure,
  outcome,
  data,
  group_vars = NULL,
  confounder = NULL, 
  priors = NULL,
  backend = "cmdstanr",
  iter = 2000,
  adapt_delta = 0.99,
  max_treedepth = 20, 
  effect_type = c("direct", "total")
) {
  effect_type <- match.arg(effect_type)

  # Determine adjustment set
  if (effect_type == "direct") {
    adjustment_set <- adjustmentSets(dag, exposure = exposure, outcome = outcome, type = c("minimal"), effect = c("direct"))
  } else if (effect_type == "total") {
    adjustment_set <- adjustmentSets(dag, exposure = exposure, outcome = outcome, type = c("minimal"), effect = "total")
  }

  if (length(adjustment_set) == 0) {
    message(paste("No adjustment set found for ", effect_type, " effect:", exposure, "→", outcome))
    adjust_vars <- character(0)
  } else {
    adjust_vars <- unlist(adjustment_set[[1]])
    message(paste("Adjustment set found for ", effect_type, " effect:", exposure, "→", outcome, "  ", adjust_vars))
  }
  
  rhs_terms <- paste(c(exposure, adjust_vars), collapse = " + ")
  formula_str <- paste(outcome, "~", rhs_terms)
  
  # Control for confounders
  if (!is.null(confounder)) {
    confounder_terms <- paste0(confounder, collapse = " + ")
    formula_str <- paste(formula_str, "+", confounder_terms)
  }

  # Add random effects if specified
  if (!is.null(group_vars)) {
    group_terms <- paste0("(1|", group_vars, ")", collapse = " + ")
    formula_str <- paste(formula_str, "+", group_terms)
  }
  message(formula_str)
  
  # Fit the model
  fit <- brm(
    bf(
    formula = as.formula(formula_str),
    autocor = cor_ar(~ year_mid | site_ID, p = 1)
    ),
    data = data,
    prior = priors,
    backend = backend,
    iter = iter,
    control = list(adapt_delta = adapt_delta, max_treedepth = max_treedepth),
    silent = TRUE
  )

  print(summary(fit))
  # Extract coefficient summary with additional quantiles
  summary_fit <- posterior_summary(fit, probs = c(0.025, 0.05, 0.95, 0.975))
  coef_name <- paste0("b_", exposure)
#  browser()
  
  if (!(coef_name %in% rownames(summary_fit))) {
    stop(paste("Coefficient", coef_name, "not found in model summary"))
  }

  coef_row <- summary_fit[coef_name, ]

  result <- data.frame(
    exposure = exposure,
    outcome = outcome,
    effect_type = effect_type,
    estimate = coef_row["Estimate"],
    ci_lower_2.5 = coef_row["Q2.5"],
    ci_lower_5 = coef_row["Q5"],
    ci_upper_95 = coef_row["Q95"],
    ci_upper_97.5 = coef_row["Q97.5"],
    formula = formula_str
  )

  rownames(result) <- NULL
  return(result)
}

```


```{r a new lme function to estimate total and direct effects}
##
run_adjusted_model_lme <- function(
  dag, exposure, outcome, data,
  group_vars = "site_ID",
  confounder = NULL,
  optional_fixed = NULL,
  time_var = "year_mid",
  use_cor = TRUE,
  cor_type = c("CAR1", "AR1"),
  method = "REML",
  effect_type = c("direct", "total")
) {
  effect_type <- match.arg(effect_type)
  cor_type <- match.arg(cor_type)

  if (length(group_vars) != 1) {
    stop("nlme::lme version allows exactly one random effect group.")
  }

  adjustment_set <- if (effect_type == "direct") {
    adjustmentSets(dag, exposure = exposure, outcome = outcome,
                   type = "minimal", effect = "direct")
  } else {
    adjustmentSets(dag, exposure = exposure, outcome = outcome,
                   type = "minimal", effect = "total")
  }

  adjust_vars <- if (length(adjustment_set) == 0) character(0) else unlist(adjustment_set[[1]])

  rhs_terms <- unique(c(exposure, adjust_vars, confounder, optional_fixed))
  formula_str <- paste(outcome, "~", paste(rhs_terms, collapse = " + "))

  random_str <- paste0("(1 | ", group_vars, ")")
  cor_str <- if (use_cor) paste0("cor", cor_type, "(~ ", time_var, " | ", group_vars, ")") else "no autocorrelation"
  formula_full_str <- paste(formula_str, "+", random_str, "+", cor_str)
  message(formula_full_str)

  data <- data %>%
    dplyr::arrange(.data[[group_vars]], .data[[time_var]])

  cor_struct <- NULL
  if (use_cor) {
    cor_formula <- as.formula(paste0("~ ", time_var, " | ", group_vars))
    cor_struct <- if (cor_type == "CAR1") {
      nlme::corCAR1(form = cor_formula)
    } else {
      nlme::corAR1(form = cor_formula)
    }
  }

  fit <- nlme::lme(
    fixed = as.formula(formula_str),
    random = as.formula(paste0("~ 1 | ", group_vars)),
    correlation = cor_struct,
    data = data,
    method = method,
    na.action = na.omit,
    control = nlme::lmeControl(
      opt = "optim",
      maxIter = 200,
      msMaxIter = 200,
      niterEM = 50,
      returnObject = TRUE
    )
  )

  tt <- summary(fit)$tTable

  if (!(exposure %in% rownames(tt))) {
    stop(paste("Coefficient", exposure, "not found in model summary"))
  }

  est <- tt[exposure, "Value"]
  se <- tt[exposure, "Std.Error"]
  df <- tt[exposure, "DF"]

  cor_coef <- if (use_cor) {
    as.numeric(coef(fit$modelStruct$corStruct, unconstrained = FALSE))
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }

  data.frame(
    exposure = exposure,
    outcome = outcome,
    effect_type = effect_type,
    estimate = est,
    se = se,
    p_value = tt[exposure, "p-value"],
    ci_lower_2.5 = est + qt(0.025, df) * se,
    ci_lower_5 = est + qt(0.05, df) * se,
    ci_upper_95 = est + qt(0.95, df) * se,
    ci_upper_97.5 = est + qt(0.975, df) * se,
    autocor_coef = cor_coef,
    formula = formula_full_str,
    row.names = NULL
  )
}

```


```{r DAGs of cold evergreen forests in cold climate}
#  
# something unexpected: CO2 -> Lgs_at; CO2_at -> Lgs_at;
# do we need all the non-growing season stuff for evergreen forests
# I need to use CO2 only, remove CO2_at to make my life easier. CO2 affect everything. 
DAG_cold_evergreen_forest <- dagitty("dag {
  
  CO2 -> TA_gs_at
  CO2 -> SW_gs_at
  CO2 -> P_gs_at
  CO2 -> LE_gs_at
  CO2 -> SWC_gs_at
  CO2 -> Lgs_at
  CO2 -> NEE_at
  
  TA_gs_at -> SWC_gs_at
  SW_gs_at -> SWC_gs_at
  P_gs_at -> SWC_gs_at
  LE_gs_at -> SWC_gs_at
  SWC_gs_at -> NEE_at
  
  P_gs_at -> SW_gs_at
  SW_gs_at -> TA_gs_at
  P_gs_at -> TA_gs_at
  P_gs_at -> NEE_at
  SW_gs_at -> NEE_at
  
  TA_gs_at -> LE_gs_at <- P_gs_at
  SW_gs_at -> LE_gs_at
  TA_gs_at -> NEE_at
  LE_gs_at -> NEE_at
  
  TA_gs_at -> Lgs_at -> NEE_at
  SWC_gs_at -> Lgs_at
  P_gs_at -> Lgs_at
  SW_gs_at -> Lgs_at
  LE_gs_at -> Lgs_at
  
  TA_ngs_at -> NEE_at
  CO2 -> TA_ngs_at
  TA_gs_at -> TA_ngs_at
  P_gs_at -> TA_ngs_at
  SW_gs_at -> TA_ngs_at
  LE_gs_at -> TA_ngs_at
  
  SWC_gs_at -> TA_ngs_at
  TA_ngs_at -> Lgs_at
  
  DIST_at -> NEE_at
  CO2 -> DIST_at
  TA_gs_at -> DIST_at  
  SW_gs_at -> DIST_at
  P_gs_at -> DIST_at
  
  DIST_at -> LE_gs_at
  DIST_at -> Lgs_at
  DIST_at -> SWC_gs_at
  
  DIST_at -> TA_ngs_at
  
}")

plot(graphLayout(DAG_cold_evergreen_forest))

isAcyclic(DAG_cold_evergreen_forest)
```

```{r DAGs of deciduous forests in cold climate}
  LE_gs_at -> NEE_at
```

```{r DAGs of non-forests in cold climate}

# something unexpected: CO2 -> Lgs_at; CO2_at -> Lgs_at; CO2 -> LE_gs_at; CO2 -> SWC_gs_at; CO2_at -> LE_gs_at; 
# something unexpected: P_gs_at -> Lgs_at; SWC_gs_at -> Lgs_at; 
# something unexpected: TA in non-growing season affects almost everything on growing-season metero conditions.
DAG_cold_non_forest <- dagitty("dag {
  CO2 -> TA_gs_at
  CO2 -> SW_gs_at
  CO2 -> P_gs_at
  CO2 -> LE_gs_at
  CO2 -> SWC_gs_at
  CO2 -> Lgs_at
  CO2 -> NEE_at
  
  TA_gs_at -> SWC_gs_at
  SW_gs_at -> SWC_gs_at
  P_gs_at -> SWC_gs_at
  LE_gs_at -> SWC_gs_at
  SWC_gs_at -> NEE_at
  
  P_gs_at -> SW_gs_at
  SW_gs_at -> TA_gs_at
  P_gs_at -> TA_gs_at
  P_gs_at -> NEE_at
  SW_gs_at -> NEE_at

  
  TA_gs_at -> LE_gs_at <- P_gs_at
  SW_gs_at -> LE_gs_at
  TA_gs_at -> NEE_at
  LE_gs_at -> NEE_at

  TA_gs_at -> Lgs_at -> NEE_at
  SWC_gs_at -> Lgs_at
  P_gs_at -> Lgs_at
  SW_gs_at -> Lgs_at
  LE_gs_at -> Lgs_at
  
  TA_ngs_at -> NEE_at
  CO2 -> TA_ngs_at
  TA_gs_at -> TA_ngs_at
  P_gs_at -> TA_ngs_at
  SW_gs_at -> TA_ngs_at
  LE_gs_at -> TA_ngs_at
  
  SWC_gs_at -> TA_ngs_at
  TA_ngs_at -> Lgs_at
  
  DIST_at -> NEE_at
  CO2 -> DIST_at
  TA_gs_at -> DIST_at 
  SW_gs_at -> DIST_at
  P_gs_at -> DIST_at  
  DIST_at -> LE_gs_at
  DIST_at -> Lgs_at
  DIST_at -> SWC_gs_at
  
  DIST_at -> TA_ngs_at
  
}")

plot(graphLayout(DAG_cold_non_forest))

isAcyclic(DAG_cold_non_forest)

  #                          effect_type = "total", data = data_cold_non_forest,

  r1 <- run_adjusted_model_lme(dag = DAG_cold_non_forest, data = data_cold_non_forest,
    exposure = exposure_var, outcome = "NEE_at", effect_type = "total", optional_fixed = c("IGBP", "source"),
    group_vars = "site_ID", time_var = "year_mid")
```
